packageRules.description: VanillaBP and the adapters follow the framework, not Renovate: their versions are bumped when a release is cut, and while they are snapshots there is nothing to look up.

The Process-Engine-API is the contract this adapter is compiled against. A new minor can change that contract, so Renovate only proposes it as a pull request, and a person decides. The job 'client-configuration' of checks.yaml lists on that pull request what the new version adds.
